hypotheses.construction_plan: Start with the two-slot kernel K(x,y)=T(x,y). The term T(i,j) is obtained by identity specialization (x,y)->(i,j). The term T(j,i) is obtained by permuting the slots of K, then specializing to (i,j); equivalently specializing (x,y)->(j,i). The full expression is the sum over the S2 orbit of the ordered pair (i,j).
required_assumptions: T is a formal two-argument function
Permutation acts on the argument order of T
proof_obligations: T(i, j) + T(j, i) - (identity[K](i, j) + permute[K](i, j)) = 0
hypotheses.rationale: The expression is exactly the symmetrization of the two-argument kernel T under the transposition (i,j). The two non-identical terms are related by argument permutation, not by leaf substitution.
